style_guidance: Lead with relatable, first-person scenarios or direct engagement prompts that invite participation ("try it now," "comment your answer"). Avoid purely informative "here's what you should know" framing. Focus on creating curiosity gaps and interactive hooks rather than educational PSAs. The tickle post and anemia challenge generated the most engagement despite low reach, suggesting format matters more than follower count.
